summary: Televisa filed a 6-K attaching a Mexican information statement on a corporate reorganization to acquire 100% of AT&T México (AT&T Comunicaciones Digitales and Grupo AT&T Celullar) via a 50/50 buyer group with Fintech Mercury. The transaction will be executed through a Mexican investment and management trust (F/6860) with Banco INVEX as trustee, governed by a shareholders agreement; Televisa's shares and CPOs remain unchanged. No price, premium, close date, or board recommendation is stated. Watch for financing, regulatory approvals, and minority governance terms.
